Overview

Snowy peaks, blue lakes and scenic trains, made for couples. Travel by Swiss Travel Pass between Zurich, Interlaken and Lucerne, go up to Jungfraujoch, the Top of Europe, stand on the Titlis Cliff Walk and cruise Lake Lucerne. Stay in hand-picked 5-star hotels.

Tour highlights

  • Swiss Travel Pass for trains, boats and buses
  • Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe
  • Mt Titlis with the rotating Rotair cable car
  • Lake Lucerne cruise
  • Rhine Falls and Zurich old town
  • Honeymoon welcome in each hotel
✈ Flights🏨 5★ Hotels🚞 Swiss Rail Pass🎿 Snow Activities

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Zurich

Fly from Mumbai to Zurich. Activate your Swiss Travel Pass. Walk around the old town and Lake Zurich.

Day 2 Rhine Falls, then to Interlaken

Morning train to Rhine Falls, Europe's largest waterfall. Continue by scenic train to Interlaken.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 Jungfraujoch – Top of Europe

Cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch (3,454 m). See the Ice Palace, Sphinx terrace and Aletsch Glacier.

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Lauterbrunnen & Grindelwald

Visit the valley of 72 waterfalls and the village of Grindelwald. Optional: Grindelwald First Cliff Walk or a paragliding flight.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Interlaken to Lucerne by Golden Pass

Scenic train to Lucerne. Walk the Chapel Bridge and see the Lion Monument.

  • Breakfast
Day 6 Mt Titlis

Day trip to Engelberg and Mt Titlis by Rotair cable car. Snow activities at Ice Flyer and the Titlis Cliff Walk.

  • Breakfast
Day 7 Lake Lucerne cruise & free time

Cruise on Lake Lucerne. Optional: Mt Pilatus or Mt Rigi. Evening free for chocolate and watch shopping.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 8 Depart for Mumbai

Train to Zurich airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast
